snippet.title: FBC: Firebreak – Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Jobs. Crisis Kits. Altered Items. Clearing the crisis. Taking on the Hiss. Here's everything you need to know to get ready to jump into FBC: Firebreak on June 17th. 

FBC: Firebreak is a 3-player cooperative first-person shooter set within the enigmatic Federal Bureau of Control (FBC). As the Bureau’s headquarters faces a deadly and prolonged siege by otherworldly forces, only Firebreak—its most adaptable response unit—has the skills and courage to restore order. 

FBC: Firebreak releases June 17th for PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5. Wishlist now!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272540/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/fbc-firebreak-fc3830
Xbox Series S|X: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/fbc-firebreak/9pdcn8z4hkrn
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012303/

Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment.

Find out more at https://playfirebreak.com.
